name: Mobile device tilt with pocket pitch
looks: A phone, held at a fixed shallow 3D tilt against a near-black field, shows the live game full-screen with touch controls. Beside it a short two-line headline and a row of device-compatibility pills (iPhone, Android, Tablet, Laptop) sit in a clean column.
build: ui-tilt-card for the phone: a DOM or textured plane under CSS/3D perspective, rotateX/rotateY fixed with a slow one-degree drift, soft blurred shadow beneath. The headline and pill row fade/slide in beside it on a short stagger.
sound: A soft whoosh as the phone settles into its tilt.
prompt: Show the product running full-screen on a phone held at a fixed, shallow 3D tilt against a dark field, with a short headline and a row of compatible-device pills beside it, to prove the same experience travels to mobile.
